newsitem.title: USA: APICS business outlook index fell to 46.8 in Nov.
newsitem.headline: APICS business outlook index fell to 46.8 in Nov.

text.p: The American Production and Inventory Control Society (APICS) business outlook index fell to 46.8 in November from 49.1 in October.
The current component rose to 48.3 from 47.7 in October, and the future component fell to 45.3 from 50.6.
A reading of 50 indicates neutral sentiment, APICS said.
"All four indicators in the future component moved below 50 in November, reinforcing the projection of lower manufacturing activity during the next three months," APICS said.

Three of four future components fell in November, APICS said. The shipments component fell to 41.9 from 50.5, production planning dipped to 49.3 from 55.1 and inventory/sales ratio declined to 43.3 from 51.1
Only unfilled orders rose, to 46.6 from 45.7.
